supports.question: In the edited image, is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
supports.criteria: pass: The mug is visibly to the right of the headphones. fail: The mug is visibly not to the right of the headphones. unknown: Their relative positions cannot be determined from the image.
supports.binding: Inspect the edited image and compare the mug’s position with the headphones; this directly tests the requested outcome.

supports.question: Does the edited image show any change to the mug’s position relative to the headphones?
supports.criteria: pass: The mug’s position relative to the headphones visibly changed. fail: The mug’s position relative to the headphones visibly did not change. unknown: A change cannot be determined from the available images.
supports.binding: Compare the original and edited images only to assess progress toward the requested relative-position change; unrelated edits do not count.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Apply the original rubric to R1 using the observations and their uncertainty. Return yes only when the edited image establishes that the mug is to the right of the headphones. Return no only when evidence establishes that no requested change has progressed. Return partial when evidence establishes some progress toward moving the mug to the right of the headphones but does not establish completion. Unrelated edits do not count. If the evidence does not establish one of these decisions, return unknown; in particular, an unknown observation must not be treated as a negative. Supporting observations are evidence only and do not independently earn completion credit.
